# victorops_team_admins (Data Source)

Get the admins for a team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "victorops_team_admins" "platform" {
  team_id = victorops_team.platform.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) The slug/ID of the team.

### Read-Only

- `admins` (List of Object) The team admins. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--admins))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
